verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago documents Webhooks and IPN notifications, automatic retries when a subscription payment is rejected, and an official MCP server that can configure and monitor webhook notifications. Its CLI can also operate payments and subscriptions with a single token, so an agent has real hooks for watching payment events. However, the retries are platform-automatic rather than agent-driven, and nothing documents failed-payment-specific events or dunning outreach. Missing for 10: documented failed/rejected-payment webhook events, agent-controllable retry API, dunning/customer outreach tooling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
